headline: TBR @ LAD matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TBR 4.51 at LAD 5.70, with a projected total of 10.21. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TBR: TBR moved +1.37 runs while LAD moved +0.91, changing the projected margin by +0.46 runs. The projected total climbed +2.28, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Nick Martinez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shohei Ohtani, Freddie Freeman, Yandy Díaz, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Chandler Simpson, Alex Freeland because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
